The ‘No Cages in the Everglades Act’ puts an end to this cruelty, protects our precious wetlands and sacred tribal lands and restores oversight and transparency.

DeSantis and Trump compete to outdo each other’s cruelty often to distract from inflation and the rising cost of living. Alligator Alcatraz is a gross and shameful abuse of human rights – caging human beings in sweltering tents with no or limited access to clean water, medical care or legal representation + a significant threat to decades of progress and millions in taxpayer $ to protect the Everglades.

The No Cages in the Everglades Act is pure political theater. Alligator Alcatraz exists because Biden’s open-border catastrophe forced states to act. Detaining illegal aliens in secure facilities isn’t “wasteful”—it’s enforcing the law. Democrats blocked every solution for years, then cry foul when states step up.

The facility operates under ICE standards, processes deportations swiftly, and addresses a crisis their policies created. Oversight? They’re invited to tour it. Accountability? Start with the 10 million illegals Biden let in.

This bill isn’t about humanity—it’s about sabotaging enforcement to keep the border chaotic.

Real reform means slashing red tape, not expanding failed programs that let bureaucrats profit while patients beg for scraps.
